# Implement a change
Read AGENTS.md, docs/project-specification.md, the task acceptance criteria, and affected code. Preserve unrelated changes. Use existing patterns and official documentation for new integration APIs.

Change the smallest coherent behavior. Protect server-side ownership and approval checks; retain private state and explicit memory rules. Use fake providers for ordinary tests and never silently switch to paid services. Add meaningful regression/failure tests rather than mirroring implementation. Update interfaces, migrations, configuration examples, and documentation when changed behavior requires them.

Run the available affected checks. Hand the actual stable revision/diff to a fresh reviewer and validator, including acceptance criteria, test commands and known limitations. Fix substantiated findings, then request targeted re-review of the delta. Do not call your own self-check independent review. Report evidence and limitations; never auto-merge or deploy merely because checks pass.
